correctness.rationale: For the once-subdivided K5 the discretized unordered 3-particle cubical complex has 455,1560,1650,520 cells. Independently reconstructed integer boundary squares vanish; exact finite-field ranks at primes 3,5,7 are (454,1100,520). The rational rank of d2 cannot exceed 1100 because the sum-of-particle-motion map surjects onto the six-dimensional H1(K5;Q), witnessed by triangle traversals with the other particles on complementary vertices. The modular lower bound then proves exact rational ranks, Betti (1,6,30,0). Signed cell Lefschetz traces and character orthogonality force H2 S5 character (30,0,-2,0,0,0,0) and multiplicities (0,1,1,2,1,1,0). Exact calculations corroborate, do not replace, discretization theorem and topological surjectivity.

value.rationale: The complete graph K5, smallest nonplanar complete graph, has a canonical automorphism group S5. Its rational unordered three-particle top homology is a natural equivariant topological invariant, not determined by its 30-dimensional rank or lower homology. The complete seven-class character identifies five Specht constituents, a repeated six-dimensional irreducible, and absence of invariants; exact finite-graph classification has independent utility and clear integral and other-particle limitations.
